method: Each exact original85vertex leaf is orthographically projected alone into a uniformly scaled atlas cell. The plane contains actual root/tip centres; transverse orientation follows actual summed cross-section width vectors; root-tip chord stays fixed. The bent hinge uses the original centreline row with maximum signed depth magnitude. No neighbouring leaves or lighting are baked. Original photographic UV/material channels preserved; data-transfer emission is offline only.
limits: 2tri flattens within each individual leaf plane. 4tri adds one source-derived bend; source fold/twist require normal transfer.
Root/tip centres exact, other vertices have explicitly measured deviations.
No runtime integration, FPS or final appearance acceptance.
normalTransfer: Flat normal map stores source normal in each leaf plane basis. Bent normal map rotates those vectors into the actual lower/upper segment tangent bases before runtime PBR transforms them back to world. No baked illumination or emission.
padding: Six texels of RGB extension only where baked alpha is zero, independently per leaf cell; alpha and nonzero-alpha RGB remain unchanged.
rootInterpretation: Source root/tip centres remain exactly on each representation. Source basal-edge/fold/twist deviations are separately measured.
